test_title: PYST 18: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark ( ? ) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1f7a237451689a7a423f7c398364a15ffc027f3af3e9ff79b8149a49f7b0e09.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Two types of movement are followed.

1) The first two elements and the last two elements are interchanged in their position mutually.

2) The first two elements and the last two elements are interchanged in their position simultaneously.

This movement occurs alternatively and so on.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/176060da101ffe618704cad6692efacfb61c78d0b99dd8b87ee0c1e94c32acca.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
